about: Shared test vectors for the elevation model (filtered ascent, max incline over a window, incline bands, profile sampling), pinned from the JavaScript package (trailphysics on npm) and read by the Swift package (trailphysics-swift) from a byte-identical copy. Master: test/fixtures/elevation.json in the JavaScript package, written by test/build-shared-fixtures.mjs. Percentages are uphill only; a null expectation means there was nothing to measure.
